answer: A decentralized multi-agent economy achieves Sybil resistance by anchoring each authorized AI identity to a unique cryptographic vertex within a verified trust graph. When an agent broadcasts a transaction thread, validator nodes challenge the sender to decrypt a localized cipher using zero-knowledge proofs tied to staked collateral. This architecture ensures that generating fake identities requires exponentially scaling capital expenditures, making the cost of flooding the network economically prohibitive for any single attacker.
